title: 日本ダービーの後に・恐るべき一等星

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The Japanese Derby reaches its conclusion with Admire Vega far in the lead. Meisho Doto was no match for her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Completely exhausted, she's not even able to bask in the joy of running such a renowned race. She leaves hoping she can one day learn to smile and enjoy these experiences.
